profile.name: Ronit Roshan Nayak
profile.summary: A Software Development Engineer with full-stack experience specializing in React, Spring Boot, and cloud data processing (AWS, Snowflake). Dedicated to architecting scalable enterprise solutions, managing complex asynchronous data workflows, and driving backend performance optimizations.

education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and System Engineering

highlights: Engineered an Aggregate Grid component featuring custom row/column 'roll-up' capabilities to filter, sort, and summarize large datasets via advanced Snowflake and Apache Spark SQL queries.
Architected a cross-tenant Import/Export framework to migrate workbooks and their underlying dependencies by extracting complex data graphs into structured JSON payloads.
Implemented an orchestrated Saga design pattern to manage asynchronous Import/Export flows utilizing AWS SQS and a MySQL request tracker.
Utilized Apache ZooKeeper to manage distributed locks and safely allocate data processing resources during execution plan computations.
Contributed to Livecube, a no-code enterprise platform featuring an Excel-like interface backed by cloud databases capable of handling millions of records.
Built interactive UI components for the Livecube Reports drag-and-drop canvas using React and React-Draggable.
Managed complex frontend states across the reporting dashboard utilizing Redux to ensure smooth data rendering and user interactions.

projects.title: College Student Info System (CSIS)
projects.description: Backend service mimicking a college SAP portal for academic record management.
features: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and JWT authentication for secure login and data management.
Real-time chat module using REST endpoints and Short Polling for student-faculty communication.

projects.title: Invoice Management System
projects.description: Full-stack system managing end-to-end invoicing between buyers and sellers.
features: Automatic invoice generation upon Purchase Order acceptance linking buyer and seller accounts.
Integrated dispute mechanism with automated email alerts.
